ruralFootprints.name: Alispántanya
ruralFootprints.note: Five actual farmyards around the preserved Alispántanya locality, east of Butyka. This deliberately discontinuous built-up footprint excludes the surrounding agricultural fields. The association of the individual farms with the locality is inferred; the locality point is a label, not a polygon generator.

ruralFootprints.name: Vadastanya
ruralFootprints.note: Mapped farmyards of the dispersed settlement northwest of Császárszállás, selected from the local source map. A partial built-up search footprint; no claim to delimit all farms or the surrounding arable land.

ruralFootprints.name: Nagylapos
ruralFootprints.note: The three separately mapped farms immediately north and east of the Nagylapos map label. This is a partial settlement footprint, not a complete field-name district. The municipal 2017 map also prints Nagylapos in this western rural part of Nyíregyháza.

ruralFootprints.name: Samókabokor
ruralFootprints.note: Six actual farmyards forming the mapped southwest-to-northeast rural cluster at the Samókabokor label. Partial built-up footprint; name-to-farm association is inferred and surrounding agricultural land is excluded.

ruralFootprints.name: Felsőbadúrbokor
ruralFootprints.note: Actual separate farmyards west of Westsik Vilmos út around the Felsőbadúrbokor label. The Hungarian National Museum archaeological locality corroborates Felső-Pázsit-Felsőbadurbokor on the west side of Westsik Vilmos utca. Partial built-up footprint; name association and which farms belong are low-confidence inferences.

sourceFootprints.name: Salamonbokor
sourceFootprints.note: Unchanged rural-residential source footprint crossed lengthwise by the mapped Salamonbokor road, south of Tiszavasvári út. The church source locates the Salamonbokor congregation at Soltész István utca1, meeting that road. Association is inferred; this is the principal residential footprint and does not claim the complete southern agricultural extent. It is distinct from Szabadságbokor and from the combined ITS planning unit.

sourceFootprints.name: Szabadságbokor
sourceFootprints.note: Unchanged rural-residential source footprint crossed by the mapped Szabadságbokor road north of Tiszavasvári út. City address/voting publications corroborate the locality. Association is inferred; this is the principal built-up footprint, not all of the named rural district. The western source footprint around Zomboribokor is not silently added.

traces.name: Báthory-lakópark
traces.note: Rough manual outline of the estate's actual local-street fabric north of Tiszavasvári út, including the Suba/Fokos/Játék and Alkotás/Tagló streets up to Levél utca. Municipal reporting explicitly places the estate on the Alkotás/Tagló bus extension. Northern and western edges are estimated transitions to rural land; street axes and estate perimeter need not coincide. The whole2.8km² CLC parent is not reused.

traces.name: Kun lakópark
traces.note: Rough outline of the small Szőlőszem street estate south of Lejtő utca, west of the Koszorú continuation and the mapped residential edge. The street guide corroborates both street names in Kun lakópark. Southern garden edges are estimated. This is an internal estate, intentionally overlapping Kistelekiszőlő's larger district.

traces.name: Kerti lak
traces.note: Rough local-street/lakeside district outline west of Kemecsei út, south of Berenát utca and north of the railway/Kemecsei junction, including the documented Zivatar utca address association. Western channel/shore-side transition is approximate. The name point is close to Tópart's; distinct overlapping historical/local labels are retained, without asserting they are synonyms.

traces.name: Tópart
traces.note: Rough manual lakeside search area around the Tópart label, extending along the Sóstói lake edge toward Berenát utca and east to Fürdő utca. Shore and park transitions are estimated from the saved OSM physical map and municipal character map. Tópart and Kerti lak have close but different source points and partially overlapping inferred extents; neither is asserted to be an official quarter border or a verified alias.

traces.name: Sóstóhegyi lakópark
traces.note: Manual trace of the small northern residential lobe in the actual source landuse map at the Sóstóhegyi lakópark label, immediately north of the Cseresznyés köz/Igrice street bend. Its outer sides follow the mapped residential/rural transition at rough map precision; the southern neck closure is inferred. Name-to-lobe association has low confidence; the large city-wide residential relation is not assigned wholesale.

traces.name: Őzdomb-lakókert
traces.note: Rough manual estate outline in the Muskotály/Új kenyér street area at the preserved Őzdomb label. The developer confirms the estate in Sóstóhegy and publishes a phased parcel map; the municipal2017 decision refers to its Muskotály access road. North/east undeveloped phase edges are estimated from the source residential transition and estate-map context. This is a search approximation, not cadastral parcel geometry.
